description:
optional, enumerated string filter
Filter item prices based on their trial_period_unit. Possible values are : day, month.
Supported operators : is, is_not, in, not_in

Example → trial_period_unit[is] = "day"

is.description: \* \`day\` - A period of 24 hours. \* \`month\` - A period of 1 calendar month.

is_not.description: \* \`day\` - A period of 24 hours. \* \`month\` - A period of 1 calendar month.
